minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  April 11, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900 -6833,
meeting ID: 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on April 11, 2024, at 2:30 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Cpt. Reginald Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez/Kenrick Sanderlin, Public Works Department
  Jazmine Covington ,Emergency Services & Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Marsha Teskete on behalf of Lavender Blue Group to host a Team Real Racing
  Experience at 3883 W. Century Blvd- Hollywood Park Casino, on Saturday, June
  15, 2024, from 11:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT
  TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event within
  Hollywood Park Casino Parking lot; Event date revision by applicant to June 15,2024
  during the April 11, 2024 P&L Meeting; Applicant to hire adequate Hollywood Park
  Casino security personnel for the safety of staff and those attending this event; TBD
  by Director of Security Barry Shapiro; Security personnel assigned shall ensure that
  there is NO underage possession or consumption of alcohol beverages (Random ID
  checks as well); IPD watch commander will be notified / extra patrol-high visibility
  will be provided as time permits; Applicant must have four (4) metal links to secure
  the event location; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
   Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384343)
Permit Request (s):

Item #2:  Gregory Johnson on behalf of Hannibal Media Group to host a Buss for America
  2024 at Kareem Court Between Manchester Blvd. and Pincay Dr Public Property,
  on Thursday, April 18, 2024 from 11:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  APPROVED  CONDITIONALLY  SUBJECT  TO  THE  FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event on Kareem Court. Subject to Public
  Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way; Applicant to hire one (1)
  Sergeant, two (2) police officers for public safety- safety of Mr. Buss / attendees;
  Applicant to hire a minimum of six (6) professional / licensed security guards to
  assist IPD with any potential crowd control ; six (6) TCO's for street closures; Four
  (4) meridian barriers to secure the event location; two barriers on each end of
  Kareem Court; Kareem / Manchester and Kareem / Pincay; Applicant to contact
  public works for approval of street closure; closure needed at 6:00 a.m.; street will
  open at 3:30 p.m.; IPD Watch Commander will be notified; Extra Patrol-High Visibility
  will be provided as time permits; must have Potter Potties with waste pans; All Fees
  must be paid seventy two (72) hrs in advance; Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384351)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
